title: How Stitches Work — 4K Medical Macro Cinema (Wound Closure, Collagen Web & Angiogenesis)

beats.name: Macro Hook: Curved Surgical Needle Weaving Blue Nylon Sutures
Zipper Closure: Thread Pulls Wound Shut + Steel Scissors SNIP
Inflammation Wave: Crimson Blush + Repair Cell Swarm
Collagen Scaffold: Golden 3D Fibers Weaving Into Living Pink Skin
Angiogenesis: Branching Ruby Blood Vessels Nourishing & Sinking In
Healed Reveal: Sutures Snipped & Pulled Out -> Seamless Skin Pullback

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: When you get a deep cut, a doctor weaves a curved surgical needle through both edges of your skin—

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: pulling the thread tight like a zipper to lock the wound shut, then snipping the ends clean.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Inside, the skin turns red and inflamed as millions of repair cells rush in to rebuild the damage.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Next, golden collagen fibers weave across the gap like living scaffolding, spinning brand new skin!

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Tiny new blood vessels branch through the seam, pumping oxygen to nourish the fresh tissue—

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: and a few weeks later, the stitches slide right out—leaving your skin healed back together!
